items.why: WTI rose after a big 8.6M barrel draw in US crude stockpiles and Hurricane Isaias shutting in Gulf production, per WSJ, with Hormuz shipping risks intact.
The fear gauge eased as the Dow and S&P firmed and Treasury yields sank into the close.
The 10-year yield fell as bonds rallied while the Dow and S&P rose, per Yahoo Finance.
Chip stocks are caught in a roughly $1 trillion wipeout as doubts grow about AI investment spending, per Business Insider and NBC.

market_note: Yields sinking, oil and gold climbing, VIX easing; Dow leading late in the session.
summary: Dow and S&P 500 climbed while the Nasdaq lagged, as falling Treasury yields cushioned the market while traders rotated out of AI-heavy chip stocks.
